question: Which sector was given top priority under the Second Five-Year Plan of India (1956-61)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Heavy and basic industries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Second Five-Year Plan (1956-61)** of India, formulated under the guidance of **P.C. Mahalanobis**, emphasized rapid industrialization as the key to economic development.
